si_tools.name: Claude Code (Anthropic), model Claude Opus 5.5
si_tools.use: Wrote and refactored the codebase, data pipelines (PDF/PSI table extraction and normalization), tests and documentation under human direction. All generated data rows carry source_id + locator and stay verified=false until a human spot-check.
si_tools.disclosure: Source files carry the header 'SI-assisted: written with Claude Code (Anthropic)'.

si_tools.name: Claude API (Anthropic), model claude-sonnet-5-5
si_tools.use: Runtime Ask EmberAtlas agent; answers are constrained to tool outputs and checked by a numeric guard. Offline demo answers are template compositions of tool outputs, labelled in the UI.

si_media: No SI-generated images or video are included. Any added later must carry a visible 'SI-generated using <tool>' watermark and must not use, contain or modify NASA logos, flags or mission identifiers.
